claims.conclusion: Arrangement terms established from the agreement.
claims.statement: DemoCo lent 100 ETH for 91 days at a 5% in-kind fee, collateralized at 150% in USDC.

claims.conclusion: Derecognize; recognize a crypto asset loan receivable.
standardRefs: AICPA Digital Assets Practice Aid — derecognition of lent crypto assets (SEC staff view)
claims.statement: The lent ETH is derecognized and a crypto asset loan receivable for 100 ETH is recognized: the borrower obtained the right to use, sell and re-pledge the ETH and DemoCo's recall right is for equivalent units, not the units transferred (SEC staff / AICPA Practice Aid analysis for crypto intangibles; ASC 860-10-40-5 considered by analogy).

claims.conclusion: Receivable at fair value of the lent asset; accrual recomputes from the agreement terms.
standardRefs: AICPA Digital Assets Practice Aid (crypto lending)
claims.statement: The receivable is measured at the fair value of the ETH to be returned (250,000 USD at 2026-06-30) and the in-kind fee accrues to 1.2466 ETH over the 91-day term, measured at the same ETH price.

The receivable of 250,000 USD is covered 1.6x by 400,000 USDC of daily-marked collateral against a 1.5x maintenance requirement; under the ASC 326-20-35-6 collateral maintenance expedient the unsecured portion (carrying amount less collateral fair value) is zero and no allowance is recorded at 2026-06-30.
The receivable, its collateral and the borrower concentration are disclosed.
